title: Customer Experience Agent – Telecoms
description: Orange Sénégal and Expresso Sénégal recruit BFEM-holders for call centre and retail customer service roles, handling billing queries, SIM registration, and product upselling. Training is provided on-site over 2–4 weeks.

title: Junior Accountant
description: Accounting firms, microfinance institutions, and SMEs in Dakar hire BTS-level junior accountants to manage bookkeeping, payroll, and VAT declarations in compliance with SYSCOHADA standards. Proficiency in Sage or QuickBooks is an asset.

title: Junior Software Developer
description: Tech startups and digital agencies in Dakar's Sacré-Cœur and Point E tech clusters actively recruit junior developers with JavaScript, Python, or PHP skills. Orange Digital Center Dakar graduates are particularly sought by local firms.

title: Agricultural Technician – Horticulture
description: Agribusiness firms and NGOs operating in the Niayes vegetable-producing corridor recruit technicians to supervise irrigation, seedling nurseries, and post-harvest handling for export-quality produce. GIZ Sénégal supports several of these placements.

title: Plumber – Commercial and Residential Installations
description: Construction companies and property management firms in greater Dakar employ certified plumbers for installation and maintenance of water supply and sanitation systems. A vocational certificate from an ADEPME-referenced training centre is frequently expected.

title: Data Entry and Administrative Clerk
description: ANSD and public sector ministries periodically recruit clerks for data entry, archiving, and administrative support roles. Candidates require strong typing skills, knowledge of office software, and good written French.

title: Broadcast Production Assistant – Radio
description: Community and private radio stations in Dakar (RFM, 7FM, Sud FM) recruit production assistants to manage schedules, edit audio, and coordinate guests. Strong oral communication in Wolof and French is essential.

title: Logistics Coordinator – Freight and Port Operations
title_local: Coordinateur Logistique – Fret et Opérations Portuaires
description: Freight forwarding companies and shipping lines operating at the Port of Dakar recruit logistics coordinators with a BTS in transport or commerce to manage container documentation, customs clearance, and client liaison.

title: Primary and Pre-school Teacher (Contract)
description: The Senegalese Ministry of National Education recruits Bac-holders as contractual teachers for rural and peri-urban primary schools, particularly in regions with teacher shortages. DER/FJ-supported teacher training bursaries are available.

title: Microfinance Loan Officer (Junior)
description: MFIs such as PAMECAS and CMS recruit junior loan officers to assess borrower creditworthiness, process applications, and monitor repayments for individual and group microloans. FONSIS-backed portfolio growth is driving new hires.

title: Smartphone Repair Technician
description: Senegal's 18+ million mobile subscribers generate constant demand for screen replacements, battery swaps, and software repairs. Independent technicians at Sandaga market or in neighbourhood kiosks earn well above minimum wage with growing clientele.

title: Vegetable Market Trader
description: Buying produce wholesale from Niayes growers and reselling at local markets (Tilène, HLM, Castors) is a well-worn pathway for youth with limited capital. Seasonal price volatility is managed by diversifying product lines.

title: Jakarta / Clando Motorcycle Taxi Operator
description: Jakarta motorcycle taxis (banned in Dakar but widespread in secondary cities) and informal clandos serve peri-urban areas where public transport is scarce. Owner-operators in cities like Ziguinchor or Saint-Louis earn 50,000–100,000 XOF monthly after fuel.

title: Street Food Vendor – Thiéboudienne and Sandwiches
title_local: Restaurateur(trice) de Rue – Thiéboudienne et Sandwichs
description: Setting up a lunch service near offices, schools, or markets serving thiéboudienne, yassa, and sandwiches can generate a reliable daily turnover of 15,000–30,000 XOF. Equipment costs are recoverable within 2–3 months for well-placed vendors.

title: Freelance Web Designer
description: Dakar's growing SME and NGO ecosystem outsources website creation to freelance designers. CTIC Dakar alumni networks and LinkedIn profiles help freelancers attract clients regionally and from the diaspora, with payment increasingly via Wave or Orange Money.

title: Tailor – African Fashion and Alterations
description: Tailors mastering wax print garments, boubous, and Western-style alterations build loyal clientele for weddings, Tabaski, and corporate orders. A home workshop with a single industrial machine and an Instagram page can generate orders within weeks.

title: Poultry Farmer – Broiler and Egg Production
title_local: Aviculteur(trice) – Poulets de Chair et Œufs
description: Poultry farming is a priority sector under the Plan Sénégal Émergent. DER/FJ provides subsidised starter kits (chicks, feed, coop materials) for youth aged 18–35, with technical support from ADEPME-registered extension workers.

title: Digital Content Creator – Wolof / French
description: Bilingual Wolof-French content creators producing comedy, lifestyle, and educational content on YouTube, TikTok, and Facebook attract brand sponsorships from telecoms, FMCG companies, and fintech startups. Monetisation requires building an audience of at least 10,000 engaged followers.

title: Second-Hand Electronics Dealer
description: Buying used phones, laptops, and accessories from the Sandaga-Fass Mbaye electronics quarter and reselling after basic refurbishment yields 20–40% margins. Technical knowledge from a repair apprenticeship gives a competitive edge in quality assessment.

title: Private Tutoring – BFEM and Bac Preparation
title_local: Cours Particuliers – Préparation BFEM et Bac
description: Youth who excelled in secondary school offer fee-paid tutoring in mathematics, physics, and French for BFEM and Baccalauréat candidates. Small group sessions (3–6 students) at 2,000–5,000 XOF per student per session maximise earnings.

title: Last-Mile Delivery Rider – Yodalivri / Delivery Platform
title_local: Livreur Dernier Kilomètre – Yodalivri / Plateforme de Livraison
description: Food delivery and e-commerce platforms operating in Dakar recruit motorcycle riders on a per-delivery commission, typically 500–1,500 XOF per drop. Earnings are entirely variable but can reach 90,000 XOF monthly for riders working full-time during peak hours.

title: Wedding and Event Photographer
description: Weddings, baptisms, business openings, and Gamou celebrations fuel consistent demand for event photographers in Dakar and Thiès. Rates range from 30,000 XOF for small events to 100,000+ XOF for premium weddings, paid in cash.

title: Online Micro-task and Transcription Worker
title_local: Travailleur Micro-tâches et Transcription en Ligne
description: Platforms like Toloka, Appen, and Remotasks pay Francophone workers for data labelling, audio transcription, and survey tasks. Earnings depend on task availability and internet access costs, making this a viable supplementary income for tech-literate youth.

title: Construction Day Worker – Bâtiment
description: Rapid urbanisation across Dakar's banlieue and secondary cities sustains steady demand for daily labourers in concrete mixing, block laying, and material handling, paid 1,800–3,500 XOF per day at active construction sites.

title: Wave / Orange Money Cash Agent (Commission-based)
title_local: Agent Mobile Money Wave / Orange Money (Commission)
description: Wave and Orange Money sub-agents earn commissions on cash-in/cash-out transactions with no fixed salary. With 75,000+ active agents nationwide, competition is high in Dakar but significant opportunity remains in peri-urban and rural areas where float of 50,000–100,000 XOF is workable.

title: Web and Mobile Development Training – Orange Digital Center Dakar
title_local: Formation Développement Web et Mobile – Orange Digital Center Dakar
description: Orange Digital Center Dakar offers free 6-month intensive coding bootcamps in web development, mobile apps, and cybersecurity for youth aged 18–35 with no Bac requirement. Graduates are connected to internship opportunities with Orange Sénégal and partner companies.

title: Entrepreneurship Incubation Programme – CTIC Dakar
description: CTIC Dakar's startup incubator accepts digital project teams at pre-revenue stage for a 4-month structured programme covering business model validation, fundraising, and tech development. No Bac is required; a viable project idea suffices.

title: Youth Agribusiness Training – DER/FJ and ADEPME
title_local: Formation Agri-entrepreneuriat Jeunes – DER/FJ et ADEPME
description: DER/FJ and ADEPME jointly deliver 8-week agribusiness training covering value chain analysis, cooperative management, and access to the DER/FJ revolving loan fund for rural and peri-urban youth with only a primary education.

title: Mobile Phone Repair Apprenticeship – Sandaga Network
description: A 3-to-6-month apprenticeship under a master technician in Dakar's Sandaga-Fass electronics district builds comprehensive skills in smartphone and feature phone repair. No education requirement; the apprentice typically contributes labour in exchange for training.

title: Financial Inclusion and Micro-Enterprise Training – GIZ Sénégal
title_local: Formation Inclusion Financière et Micro-Entreprise – GIZ Sénégal
description: GIZ Sénégal's ProFil programme delivers 5-week financial literacy and business planning workshops for out-of-school youth with no minimum education. Graduates receive coaching on Wave and Orange Money business account management and connection to SFD microfinance partners.
